name: Tree Swallow
desc: Tree Swallow (Tachycineta bicolor): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The tree swallow is a migratory bird of the family Hirundinidae. Found in the Americas, the tree swallow was first described in 1807 by French ornithologist Louis Vieillot as Hirundo bicolor.
